name: h3-reauthor
description: TEMPLATE (f): tpl-hdb-3room re-authored — the bedroom wing was sealed off (nothing pierced h3-liv-w), the Common Bath was open to the kitchen and living, the Master Bath shared a volume with Bedroom 2, and Bedroom 2's window sat in the kitchen. Asserts geometry and screenshots the 2D plan.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-master-fits-a-bed
steps.eval: (()=>{const m=window.__store.getState().floorPlan.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='h3-master'); const longest=Math.max(m.width,m.depth); if(longest<2.2) throw new Error('master longest side '+longest); return m.width+' x '+m.depth})()

steps.name: assert-every-room-reachable
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const need=['h3-kit','h3-yard','h3-shelter','h3-cbath','h3-living','h3-master','h3-mbath','h3-bed2']; const missing=need.filter(id=>!s.rooms.find(x=>x.id===id)); if(missing.length) throw new Error('missing: '+missing); const wingDoors=s.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='door'&&o.wallId==='h3-liv-w'); if(wingDoors.length!==1) throw new Error('expected exactly ONE door on h3-liv-w, got '+wingDoors.length); return s.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='door').length+' doors'})()

steps.name: assert-baths-enclosed
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const need=['h3-cb-w','h3-cb-s','h3-mb-e']; const missing=need.filter(id=>!s.walls.find(w=>w.id===id)); if(missing.length) throw new Error('missing enclosure walls: '+missing); const b2w=s.openings.find(o=>o.id==='h3-b2-win'); if(b2w.wallId!=='h3-s') throw new Error('bed2 window still on '+b2w.wallId); return 'baths enclosed, bed2 window on its own wall'})()
